description: Defines the CommandContext class used for handling command resources and methods in batch processing within the Fineract project. Implements builder pattern and matching logic.

classes.name: CommandContext
classes.description: Immutable class representing a command's resource and method, with builder pattern and matching logic.

methods.name: matcher
methods.description: Checks if the resource regex matches another CommandContext's resource and if methods are equal.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on resource and method.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another CommandContext object.

methods.name: resource
methods.description: Static method to initiate builder with resource string.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds a CommandContext instance from builder.

methods.name: method
methods.description: Sets the method in the builder.
